title: Scenario-driven executive readout: contingency lanes & investment asks

description: Prepare a compact, scenario-driven executive readout for the upcoming QBR that presents three investment lanes (base, defend, accelerate) and explicit contingency triggers. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, Finance, and GTM inputs, and aligns on the ask and fallback asks for the Board and Execs.
